As remediation, the service was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. From the deployment history, **v2.3.0** was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only ever staged, and never healthy).

2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions via rollback. Verified post-rollback: the service is now **healthy in all three regions** with an error rate of ~0.2% (down from 18%).

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged): "checkout-api rolled back from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 after post-deploy health check failures," documenting the health failures, the rollback action, and the verified recovery.

Note: v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so redeploying it would require change-manager approval per policy.
